* carrier's permit - 2 days of increased inventory limit by 100 items
* concealer's permit - 2 days of access to items that hide parts of inventory
* fashionista's license - 2 days of access to additional inventory slots
* personality profile - 2 days of access to change settings in PROFILE
* sealed writ - 7 days of access to become a citizen of a province
* speaker's pass - 1 hour of access to set your default SAY emote
* title scroll - 1 hour of access to changing your titles
(For more info see https://elanthipedia.play.net/Random_creature_drop#Free_Account_Booster_Items)

items.name: an ice-veined leather kilt fastened with an icesteel pin
items.tap: an ice-veined leather kilt fastened with an icesteel pin
items.description:
Stiffly pleated, the tailored kilt is designed to wrap around the waist and end just below the knees.  Thick hiro bear fur lines its interior, shielding the wearer from the brunt of the fabric's icy properties.
The barest hint of a blue-white shimmer appears across the surface of the leather.

items.name: an icethorn battle crossbow with a blood-red whipcord
items.tap: an icethorn battle crossbow with a blood-red whipcord
items.description: Tiny crystalline icicles glisten against the finely grained snow-white wood which makes up the stock and prod of the weapon.  Lashing the stock to the prod is a bright blood-red whipcord, starkly contrasting the quiet beauty of the wood.

items.name: an indurium lockpick tailband etched with a shrew
items.tap: an indurium lockpick tailband etched with a shrew
items.description: The brushed indurium of this lockpick ring has a vibrant red finish.  Leather straps allow this item to be attached to a tail.  Across the ring, a shrew with wings that extend in a rainbow is intricately etched into the metal, leaving a pattern that contrasts the material of the ring.

items.name: an iron shield painted with a fluffy cloud
items.tap: an iron shield painted with a fluffy cloud
items.description: Picked out in white paint on a pale blue background, the puffy cloud has light grey shadows amongst its pure white expanse.

items.description: The vial contains a strange yellow substance.  The word "Verve" is printed beneath a crude drawing of a rat on the label.
